enable-360-mouse-vr-present.comment: Checkbox label - Enables/disables VR/360-degree captured mouse mode automatically depending on VR user presence - normally via a proximity sensor in the headset (VR = virtual reality)

strings.enable-360-mouse-vr-present: Enable 360 mouse when VR is in use

head-tracked-sound.comment: Checkbox label - makes surround sound relative to VR tracked head orientation (VR = virtual reality)

openxr-info.comment: Subtitle before VR status information (VR = virtual reality)

openxr-runtime-format.comment: %s = OpenXR runtime name as provided by the runtime

openxr-system-format.comment: %s = OpenXR system name as provided by the OpenXR runtime

show-3d-mouse-cursor-always.comment: Checkbox label - Shows the 3D mouse cursor always, even when VR is not running (VR = virtual reality)

show-3d-mouse-cursor-in-vr.comment: Checkbox label - Shows the 3D mouse cursor when VR is running (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror.comment: Checkbox label - Enables preview of VR display in desktop window (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-automatic.comment: Combo item label - Choose what to show on desktop preview of VR display automatically (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-left.comment: Combo item label - Show left eye view on desktop preview of VR display (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-left-right.comment: Combo item label - Show side-by-side left & right eye views on desktop preview of VR display (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-mode.comment: Combobox label - Choose what to show on desktop preview of VR display (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-none.comment: Combo item label - Show nothing on desktop preview of VR display (VR = virtual reality)

vr-desktop-mirror-right.comment: Combo item label - Show right eye view on desktop preview of VR display (VR = virtual reality)

vr-mouse-sensitivity.comment: Slider label - controls sensitivity of VR/360-degree captured mouse mode (VR = virtual reality)

vr-mouse-sensitivity-format.comment: Slider value format - VR/360-degree captured mouse mode sensitivity, in degrees of angular motion per pixel of mouse motion (VR = virtual reality)

vr-state-format.comment: %s = VR current state string (VR = virtual reality)
